title: Confidence worked examples, per-meter, N-visits, No-data
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as an Owner/Admin (Settings Service), on the build under test. The Maintenance Reminders feature is on (behind the maintenance_reminders flag). These are numeric/date-accuracy cases (Rule 116): seed the exact inputs, read the produced value back, and compare it to the stated value - never eyeball, never accept "a number".
  2. A unit whose mileage and engine-hours histories can be seeded independently. Compute every expected value by hand first.
custom_steps:
1. Seed six visits with five usable pairs, last reading 120 days old, and read the grade.
  2. Seed two visits read yesterday with one usable pair, and read the grade.
  3. Seed a strong mileage history and a weak engine-hours history on one unit and read both meters' grades.
  4. On a card showing "from N visits", seed a visit whose only pairs were discarded and read N.
  5. Seed a unit with nothing to estimate from and read the state and which basis governs the due date.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Six visits, five pairs, last reading 120 days old: count says High, age caps at Medium -> shows Medium. Two visits read yesterday, one pair: age allows High, count says Low -> shows Low.
  • Distance and engine hours each carry their own confidence, computed independently, so one unit can show a strong mileage grade and a weaker hours grade at once.
  • "from N visits" counts readings that took part in at least one usable pair; a visit whose only pairs were discarded does not count.
  • No data is a separate state, not a confidence level: nothing to estimate from, the calendar governs, and the row says the meter has no basis yet.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780; Chunk 1 MR spec (Confluence 886931488), the confidence matrix (S11-R22/R23/R24/R25/E5), reproduced in the spec as the basis for the S9 asset-tab and S13 worklist confidence display; read 29 Sep 2026. Source-verified 29 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S11-E5: “Six visits, five usable pairs, the last reading 120 days old: the count says High, the age caps it at Medium, and Medium is what the unit shows. Two visits read yesterday, one usable pair: the age allows High, the count says Low, and Low is what it shows”
  • S11-R10: “Distance and engine hours will each carry their own confidence, computed independently”
  • S11-R25: “Measured from N visits, where a card shows it, counts the readings that took part in at least one usable pair. A visit whose only pairs were discarded does not count”
  • S11-R17: “No data is a separate state, not a confidence level. It applies where there is nothing to estimate from, the calendar governs, and the row says the meter has no basis yet”
